services.title: Facebook Page Recovery
services.summary: Recovering ownership and administrator access to Facebook Pages that have been compromised, hijacked, or lost.
services.problem: Facebook Pages are frequently targeted for takeover, leaving the legitimate administrator locked out — sometimes for extended periods — while the page's content, audience, and reputation remain at risk.
services.approach: I investigate the nature of the compromise, work through Meta's review and verification processes, and focus on restoring legitimate administrator access and securing the page once control is regained.
services.expectedOutcomes: Every case is different, and recovery depends on the nature of the issue, platform policies, and available evidence. I do not guarantee recovery, but I bring a structured, evidence-based approach to every case.

services.title: Facebook Account Recovery
services.summary: Recovering compromised or inaccessible personal Facebook accounts.
services.problem: A hacked or disabled personal Facebook account can cut off access to years of connections, business communication, and linked assets like Pages and ad accounts.
services.approach: I assess how the account was compromised, guide the ownership-verification process, and work to restore legitimate access while closing the security gap that allowed the compromise.
services.expectedOutcomes: Recovery outcomes vary by case. I do not guarantee recovery, but I apply the same structured process to every account I work on.

services.title: Instagram Account Recovery
services.summary: Recovering compromised or inaccessible Instagram accounts.
services.problem: Instagram account takeovers can lock out creators and businesses from their audience, content history, and any linked Meta Business assets.
services.approach: I investigate the compromise, guide the account-ownership verification process with Meta, and work toward restoring legitimate access.
services.expectedOutcomes: Every case is evaluated individually, and I do not guarantee recovery — but I apply a consistent, evidence-based process to each one.

services.title: Meta Business Manager Recovery
services.summary: Recovering hacked or restricted Meta Business Managers, including their linked Pages, ad accounts, and assets.
services.problem: A compromised or restricted Business Manager can affect every asset connected to it at once — Pages, ad accounts, and team access — making this one of the more complex recovery scenarios.
services.approach: I investigate the scope of the compromise or restriction, work through Meta's Business Manager review and verification processes, and focus on restoring legitimate administrator control across all affected assets.
services.expectedOutcomes: Outcomes depend on the specifics of each Business Manager and the nature of the issue. I do not guarantee recovery, but I bring direct experience recovering hacked and restricted Business Managers to every engagement.

services.title: Business Verification Guidance
services.summary: Guiding businesses through Meta Business Manager verification, including resolving restrictions that block the process.
services.problem: Meta's business verification process can be blocked by prior restrictions, unclear requirements, or incomplete documentation, leaving legitimate businesses unable to verify.
services.approach: I review the current state of the Business Manager, resolve any restrictions standing in the way, and guide the business through preparing for and completing Meta's verification process.
services.expectedOutcomes: Verification outcomes depend on Meta's own review. I do not guarantee approval, but I focus on ensuring the Business Manager is correctly prepared before submission.

services.title: Admin Dispute Resolution
services.summary: Resolving disputes over Page or Business Manager administrator access and asset ownership.
services.problem: Disputes over who legitimately administers a Page or Business Manager can leave assets frozen or contested, especially after a change in team, a former employee's continued access, or a takeover attempt.
services.approach: I review the ownership and administrative history of the asset, help establish legitimate ownership through Meta's dispute and verification channels, and work toward a resolution that restores proper control.
services.expectedOutcomes: Every dispute is evaluated on its own facts. I do not guarantee a specific outcome, but I approach each case with careful documentation and a clear process.

services.title: Security Consultation
services.summary: Advising businesses and creators on strengthening the security of their social media accounts and Business Manager setup.
services.problem: Many account compromises are preventable — weak admin structures, missing two-factor authentication, and unclear asset ownership all increase risk.
services.approach: I review the current security posture of your accounts and Business Manager, identify the specific gaps most likely to lead to compromise, and recommend practical steps to close them.
services.expectedOutcomes: Consultation strengthens your security posture going forward; it does not retroactively address an active compromise, which falls under the relevant recovery service instead.

services.title: Social Media Security Audit
services.summary: A structured review of your social media and Business Manager accounts to identify security risks before they become incidents.
services.problem: Businesses often don't have visibility into who has access to their Pages, ad accounts, and Business Manager, or which settings leave them exposed.
services.approach: I audit administrator access, asset ownership, and account-level security settings across your Facebook, Instagram, and Business Manager presence, and provide a clear summary of findings and recommendations.
services.expectedOutcomes: An audit identifies risk areas and recommended fixes; it is a preventative service, distinct from active account recovery.
